name: Your Body
overview: Scripture teaches that our bodies are sanctified and known by God even before birth, as seen in Jeremiah 1:5, emphasizing the divine purpose and care for our physical being. We are called to honor and present our bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, according to Romans 12:1. Leviticus 19:28 warns against marking the body with cuttings or tattoos, reflecting God's desire for our bodies to remain unblemished in certain ways. Additionally, Matthew 6:22 highlights the importance of spiritual clarity and purity, which affects the whole body, underscoring the interconnectedness of physical and spiritual health.
